description: Gets photos for one or more hotels (up to 8), up to 3 per category: rooms, bathrooms, dining, amenities such as the pool and gym, public spaces such as the lobby, exterior, views and nearby attractions. Hotels with no categories get up to 12 photos with no category. Use this tool for room photos too, because hotels_get_rooms gives only one image per room type. Use categoryFocus to show some categories first. missingHotelIds lists the hotels that could not be loaded.

categoryFocus.description: Photo categories to show first (does not filter). Pool and gym photos are in Amenities, lobby photos are in Public Spaces. Categories: Rooms, Bathrooms, Dining, Amenities, Public Spaces, Exterior, Views, Nearby Attractions, Others.

hotelIds.description: Array of hotel IDs to fetch photos for (1-8 hotels)

locale.description: Locale for the hotel name (e.g., 'en', 'ar'). Category names and photo descriptions are always English.

name: hotels_get_photos
title: Get Hotel Photos
